races.name: EHB Residential Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Louis Veron
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid hurdle form but disappointed as favourite last time, 23 days since last run should have him sharp
runners_data.spotlight: Close second in 15-runner Chepstow novice (2m, good to soft) on debut in October; absent until turned over at skinny odds at Southwell (2m, good) last month but the winner was a useful Flat performer who has since followed up; ought to go one better here.

runners_data.name: Colibri Bleu
runners_data.note: Unknown quantity from pointing background making rules debut, trainer Ellis struggling with 1/4 strike rate
runners_data.spotlight: Won a two-runner maiden point in March 2025 but failed to complete his next five points; makes very limited appeal on rules debut.

runners_data.name: Connemara Joe
runners_data.note: Another pointing graduate with poor record, unplaced in seven Irish points including last run on soft
runners_data.spotlight: Unplaced in all seven Irish points, most recently when pulled up on soft ground in April; can only be watched on this rules debut.

runners_data.name: Dunstall Star
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won his bumper and showed promise on hurdling debut, may struggle if pace is slow
runners_data.spotlight: Led close home to win modest Exeter bumper (good ground) in April and made a lot of the running over C&D on last month's hurdling debut, albeit he was held in third before last-flight fall; his tendency to race too freely is a worry but he has a good chance to collect at least a minor prize.

runners_data.name: Garde My Guinness
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with headgear fitted, consistent but unspectacular bumper form, 7lb weight allowance
runners_data.comment: Off since disappointing hurdle debut in September but was third in all three bumpers
runners_data.spotlight: Third in three good-ground bumpers in early part of last season but the form isn't anything to get excited about, and she was soundly beaten on her first two hurdling starts, the latter last month, after a layoff.

runners_data.name: Lyric
runners_data.note: Former Flat horse making hurdling transition, 75 days since last disappointing run raises fitness concerns
runners_data.spotlight: Showed some useful Flat form for the Gosden stable in 2024 but last year's stable debut was disappointing and he made a low-key start to his hurdling career when eighth of ten in Musselburgh maiden (2m1f, good to soft; jumping lacked fluency) in March; needs to take a big step forward.

runners_data.name: Chambers
runners_data.note: Flat convert on only second hurdle start, 4-year-old receiving weight but showed little impact at Fontwell
runners_data.comment: 0-8 on the Flat and was well held on hurdling debut at Fontwell two weeks ago
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown some ability on the Flat (albeit without being placed) and wasn't disgraced when sixth on last month's hurdle debut at Fontwell (2m1f, good) but was well beaten after racing too freely at Bangor 11 days ago.

races.paceDynamic: Louis Veron will take the early lead with his prominent style, setting a steady tempo in this small field of seven. With no other confirmed front-runners and most rivals adopting prominent or hold-up tactics, he'll face minimal early pressure and can dictate terms. The lack of pace pressure means the race will likely develop into a tactical affair with runners queuing up behind the leader. This setup strongly favours prominent runners who can track Louis Veron and challenge from close range, rather than hold-up horses who will struggle to make up ground in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Louis Veron sets modest fractions without early pressure...
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish with prominent runners perfectly positioned to strike. Hold-up horses like Dunstall Star get caught too far back as the pace quickens late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Louis Veron goes too slow or gets headed early...
scenarios.body: Multiple prominent runners bunch up and create a messy tactical finish with little galloping room. The best jumper and most experienced hurdler prevails in the scrum.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Point Horses Fire
scenarios.trigger: If Colibri Bleu or Connemara Joe show unexpected improvement from pointing...
scenarios.body: Their superior stamina base kicks in during the final half-mile despite rules inexperience. The maiden hurdle becomes a test of raw ability over technique.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Quickens Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Louis Veron from early stages...
scenarios.body: A genuine gallop develops that exposes the limited experience of several runners. Class and proven hurdling ability becomes decisive.

watchPoints.text: Colibri Bleu and Connemara Joe are complete unknowns from pointing - any market confidence would be significant given their poor point form
Louis Veron's odds will reveal connections' confidence after his disappointing favourite's effort last time at Southwell
Watch for any late jockey changes given several conditional riders booked including Ned Fox and Joe Anderson
Early pace will be crucial - if Louis Veron goes too slowly, the hold-up horses become live dangers in a sprint finish
Garde My Guinness has headgear applied for first time over hurdles which could spark improvement from this consistent mare

races.name: Insight Surveyors Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Baltray
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose Newton Abbot third over this trip reads well, but needs to avoid the traffic problems his style creates
runners_data.comment: Has struggled in his last two starts and has stamina to prove at this new trip
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to add to his maiden hurdle win in 2023 but fairly lightly raced in the meantime and ran quite well when third at Newton Abbot (3m2f, good) last month; still unexposed over this sort of trip; raced mainly on good ground; could have a say.

runners_data.name: Spitalfield
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse wearing cheekpieces for the second time after improved third here last month, though didn't find much late
runners_data.comment: No form earlier this year and plenty depends on whether cheekpieces can trigger something
runners_data.spotlight: Ended string of heavy defeats when third in first-time cheekpieces here (3m1f, good; handes soft) last month but didn't find much in the closing stages, and it's hard to tell whether he'll build on that performance.

runners_data.name: Walkinthecotswolds
runners_data.note: Prominent runner now 9lb lower than his last win but poor completion record suggests stamina/jumping concerns
runners_data.comment: 9lb below the mark of her sole hurdling win, but yet to prove herself over fences.
runners_data.spotlight: Now 9lb lower than when making all over hurdles at Chepstow (2m3f, heavy) in early 2025 but has poor completion record in the meantime; pulled up soon after bad jumping error in early stages of a recent chase and now reverts to hurdling; the forecast rain will aid her cause but her stamina is unproven and she can't be supported with much confidence.

runners_data.name: Tyson
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in excellent form for Dan Skelton with 10l win nine days ago, perfectly placed to capitalize on pace scenarios
runners_data.comment: Sole bright spot for this yard was the win at Newcastle; an underwhelming run since
runners_data.spotlight: Started off for Dan Skelton with some disappointing efforts but comfortably drew 10l clear at Huntingdon (2m4f, good to firm) nine days ago and has now won two of his last three; probably still well treated under 7lb penalty here and won't mind if the ground softens; hard to beat if stamina holds out on first venture beyond 2m6f.

runners_data.name: Luna Run
runners_data.note: Prominent runner disappointing since stable switch but tongue-tie first time might help, carried 7lb claimer
runners_data.spotlight: Just 1-16 over hurdles when trained by Evan Williams and was unable to justify odds-on favouritism when only sixth of 12 here (2m5f, good) on last month's stable debut; may yet come good for Harry Derham, though, and this move back up in trip will suit; wears refitted tongue-tie; gained her win on good to firm but has form on good to soft; 3lb wrong.

runners_data.name: Groom De Cotte
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 62-day break with tongue-tie, lackluster last run in April raises fitness concerns
runners_data.spotlight: Won over fences 13 months ago but returned from layoff with lacklustre hurdle run in April and is difficult to enthuse over after that performance; has usual tongue-tie refitted; seems versatile ground-wise.

runners_data.name: Touchwoodexpress
runners_data.note: Only front runner back from 193-day absence, won over this trip at Newton Abbot but needs to handle the layoff
runners_data.comment: Beaten long way last time; possibilities if back to the form of his reappearance win
runners_data.spotlight: Absent since two below-par runs in November but returned from a break to win five-runner contest at Newton Abbot (3m2f, good) in September, and is now back on the same mark; seems best on good ground but once won a point on soft; can't be ruled out.

runners_data.name: Broadway Honey
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who made bad jumping error when travelling well last time, now 0-6 over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten about 28l when fifth of six here (3m1f, good) last month and is now 0-6 over hurdles; seemed to be travelling okay in the lead before bad jumping error knocked the stuffing out of him that day and remains unexposed over this sort of trip but, nevertheless, others have stronger claims; raced only on good/good to soft ground.

runners_data.name: Hitthekettle
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse effectively 9lb higher than last run, unplaced in all nine hurdling starts but carried 5lb claimer
runners_data.spotlight: Unplaced all nine hurdling starts; gave fairly good account before weakening into fourth of seven over C&D (good) in March but is effectively 9lb higher from out of the weights today; gained his point win on soft to heavy ground.

races.paceDynamic: Touchwoodexpress is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead on his return from a 193-day break. The main battle will be for prominent positions with Baltray, Walkinthecotswolds, Luna Run and Groom De Cotte all wanting to track the leader, creating congestion 2-3 hurdles out as they look to challenge. The hold-up horses Spitalfield, Tyson, Broadway Honey and Hitthekettle will be relying on the pace collapsing or finding gaps late. This race shape clearly favours the patient hold-up horses who can benefit from the prominent runners getting in each other's way while Touchwoodexpress potentially sets up the race from the front.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Patient Hold-Up Profits
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack gets tangled up 2-3 out while chasing Touchwoodexpress
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get clear runs as the early pace collapses, with Skelton's improving form and tactical riding proving decisive. Fresh legs from deep positions capitalize on the early skirmishing.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Touchwoodexpress gets soft fractions and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: The long absence becomes irrelevant as he builds an unassailable lead, with the prominent pack too far back after their traffic problems. His Newton Abbot form over this trip looks solid enough.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Breaks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent quartet gets first run on Touchwoodexpress without interference
scenarios.body: Baltray or Luna Run uses their class edge to dominate the finish, getting the jump on both the tiring leader and the still-gathering hold-up horses. Early positioning proves crucial.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Touchwoodexpress sets crawling fractions and the field comes together late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class trumps tactics, but the bunched finish creates chaos at the business end. Form horses with finishing speed benefit most.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic congestion 2-3 hurdles out as Baltray, Luna Run, Walkinthecotswolds and Groom De Cotte all converge on Touchwoodexpress
Monitor Touchwoodexpress early for signs of ring-rustiness after 193 days off, particularly his jumping rhythm
Watch Spitalfield's finishing effort in cheekpieces for second time after finding little late when third here last month
Observe if Luna Run's tongue-tie first time helps her settle better in the prominent pack under the 7lb claimer
Check Tyson's position turning in as he has the best recent form to capitalize if the pace collapses

races.name: Virtus Property Services Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Amatchmadeinheaven
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner with class edge but faces pace pressure from Midnight View and carries 168lbs top weight
runners_data.spotlight: Unexposed 5yo who won under owner-jockey Amber Jackson-Fennell on hurdle debut at Exeter (2m, good to soft) in March; below that form over 2m5f in April (raced too freely) but remains open to improvement on this handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Dream's Ka
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who won readily last time at Bangor and should benefit from expected strong pace
runners_data.comment: 2l second at Fakenham latest (2m4f, good); player if he can settle better this time.
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark over hurdles at seventh attempt, with ready success at Bangor (2m3f, good; has been placed on good to soft) last month; seemed to have a lot left in the tank that day and commands respect here, despite subsequent 12lb rise.

runners_data.name: Kentucky River
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with flat racing speed but well beaten last time at Fakenham in valuable contest
runners_data.spotlight: Fair Flat racer who won easily over hurdles at Huntingdon (2m4f, good) in April, his second handicap; well beaten in valuable Fakenham contest since but back in calmer waters and on a more conventional track here; remains of interest, albeit the forecast rain may not be in his favour.

runners_data.name: Midnight View
runners_data.note: Course and distance winner who leads/tracks pace but may struggle to dominate against Amatchmadeinheaven
runners_data.comment: Has a lot less to prove than his rivals after winning over Warwick's 2m3f last time
runners_data.spotlight: Kept on well to score over C&D (good) in April, his ninth start over hurdles; still unexposed over this sort of trip but was a shade disappointing when well-held third at Ludlow (2m5f, good) last month and probably won't be favoured by any rain.

runners_data.name: Modern Style
runners_data.note: Progressive hold-up horse with two recent wins on good ground but facing stiffer opposition here
runners_data.comment: On a hat-trick after wins on good at Exeter (2m) and Taunton (2m3f); up 14lb; contender
runners_data.spotlight: Launched handicap career with two comfortable wins on good ground (2m/2m3f; unraced on ground any slower) in April, and ran well in defeat at Uttoxeter (2m, good) last month; back up in trip here and probably still on the upgrade; must be considered.

races.paceDynamic: Amatchmadeinheaven and Midnight View both show prominent/lead tendencies and will contest the early pace over this 2m3f trip. With just 5 runners, the pace battle between these two should create an honest gallop throughout, preventing either from stealing a march. The strong pace will set up the race for the hold-up horses to come from behind in the closing stages. This pace scenario clearly favours the hold-up runners who can benefit from the strong early gallop and finish with late momentum.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If Amatchmadeinheaven and Midnight View engage in a sustained pace battle through the early stages
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will perfectly set up Dream's Ka, Kentucky River and Modern Style to close from off the pace. Hold-up specialists benefit most when prominent runners clash early over this stamina-testing distance.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters manages to break clear of their rival and dictate terms alone
scenarios.body: Either Amatchmadeinheaven or Midnight View could steal a march if they avoid a prolonged duel and find the right rhythm. The small field reduces the closing threat if the leader finds the right tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Stalemate Benefits Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners are cautious early and the pace becomes steadier than expected
scenarios.body: A slower pace would prevent the hold-up horses from having enough pace to aim at in the closing stages. Amatchmadeinheaven's class advantage could prove decisive if the race becomes more tactical.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Closer From Midfield
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and none of the usual front runners commit early
scenarios.body: Kentucky River could benefit from his flat racing speed if the race becomes a sprint finish. This scenario requires perfect timing from the Murphy stable but seems unlikely given the confirmed pace angles.

watchPoints.text: Amatchmadeinheaven carries significant weight advantage for amateur jockey Miss Jackson-Fennell in what could be a tactical battle
Dream's Ka showed plenty in hand at Bangor last time and Skelton team have strong recent record at Warwick
Modern Style has won his last two starts comfortably but faces a step up in class against more experienced handicappers
Kentucky River needs the pace to develop strongly given his hold-up style but disappointed badly last time out
Midnight View knows the track well after course and distance success but will need to handle pace pressure from Amatchmadeinheaven

races.name: Rainier Developments Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Thickthorn Tom
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in good form with headgear helping, well-suited to track the likely soft pace set by Carpe Diem.
runners_data.comment: Unexposed chaser who was a clear second off this mark at Fontwell latest; leading claims
runners_data.spotlight: Better for this headgear combination, following his second at Fontwell with a narrow but comfortable success at Newton Abbot last week (2m5f, good) for which he carries a penalty; sure to go well over a trip he stays.

runners_data.name: Northern Symphonie
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but chase inexperience shows and 24 days off may leave her short of peak fitness.
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner but below her best in that discipline for current yard and again when a remote third on chase debut at Ludlow (2m4f, good; first-time cheekpieces after wind surgery); others preferred.

runners_data.name: King Of The Story
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage against weak pace but has proven class edge over this field.
runners_data.comment: Fourth at Fontwell on his return last month following a five-month break.
runners_data.spotlight: All four chase wins have come over shorter distances but this far is worth a go; ran quite well after a break at Fontwell and when beaten 27l into second here last time he was going well when clouting four out.

runners_data.name: Carpe Diem
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with no pace pressure faces perfect scenario, though 7lb claimer Tom Hutsby adds slight concern.
runners_data.comment: Wide-margin 2m4f winner in February; up weights; creditable 3m3f run latest; good claims
runners_data.spotlight: Has continued to run well since his Huntingdon win in Februaray (2m4f, soft), last time giving everything in a narrow defeat over C&D; 2lb higher with Tom Hutsby again aboard; should have every chance.

runners_data.name: Pescatorius
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has declined since stable switch and faces wrong race shape with weak early pace.
runners_data.comment: Won twice for Olly Murphy in the autumn but hasn't been in the same form since.
runners_data.spotlight: Left Olly Murphy for 5,500gns and pretty much tailed off in four handicap chases since.

runners_data.name: Knightsbridge
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 69-day break whose chase inexperience makes him vulnerable despite good recent hurdles form.
runners_data.comment: The drop back in trip could help on chase debut but he has to improve upon his hurdle form
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles but was close up in a 2m3f handicap off 5lb higher; ran okay when 8l off the winner on chase debut here in March (2m4f, good) and worth another go at 3m.

runners_data.name: Misteroddsocks
runners_data.note: Prominent style fits but 5lb rise for Fontwell win looks harsh given subsequent poor form there.
runners_data.comment: Wind surgery before opening account over C&D (good to soft) last month; big player
runners_data.spotlight: Back from wind surgery when winning narrowly at Fontwell (2m3f, good to soft) but well beaten off this 5lb higher mark back there, finishing behind Thickthorn Tom; unraced beyond 2m5f.

races.paceDynamic: Carpe Diem is the sole confirmed front runner and will set an uncontested lead from the start, with Thickthorn Tom, Northern Symphonie, Knightsbridge and Misteroddsocks likely to race prominently behind him. The lack of pace pressure means Carpe Diem can dictate terms and control fractions, while King Of The Story and Pescatorius will need to overcome their hold-up styles against a potentially slow pace. With minimal early speed and one unchallenged leader, this race strongly favors the front runner and prominent racers who can stay close to the pace throughout.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Carpe Diem Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Carpe Diem gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows him to save energy early before unleashing his finishing kick, with the hold-up horses left with too much ground to make up. His proven course form and ability to quicken off slow fractions makes him very dangerous.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Tells
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent racers press Carpe Diem and create a more genuine pace
scenarios.body: Thickthorn Tom and Northern Symphonie benefit from a truer gallop that brings stamina into play over this 3-mile trip. The increased pace sets up perfectly for their prominent racing styles while weakening the leader's kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Late Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: King Of The Story's proven finishing kick becomes a major weapon in a slowly-run race that turns into a dash from the last fence. His class advantage shows when the race becomes about pure speed rather than stamina.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent horses fail to lay up and Carpe Diem gets lonely in front
scenarios.body: The ultra-slow fractions completely negate stamina advantages and turn this into a pure sprint where any horse can win from anywhere. Form goes out the window in a blanket finish where positioning at the last fence matters most.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Carpe Diem gets pressured early by the prominent racers as this would completely change the race dynamic
Watch Thickthorn Tom's jumping under pressure as any mistakes would hand the race to Carpe Diem
Watch King Of The Story's position turning for home as he needs to be closer than usual given the likely weak pace
Watch Northern Symphonie's fitness levels given her 24-day absence and limited chase experience
Watch Tom Hutsby's 7lb claim on Carpe Diem as any tactical errors from the inexperienced rider could cost a winning position

races.name: Stockton House Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Northern Air
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with class but needs the leaders to come back to her over this shorter trip
runners_data.comment: Ran encouragingly last time on stable debut and switch back to hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Another underwhelming run over fences last time but was only a length behind an improver over hurdles at Newton Abbot two runs back (2m1f, good) and that effort brings her into this.

runners_data.name: Siorai
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid handicap form who should get a perfect tracking position behind Best Night
runners_data.comment: May progress now handicapping, especially if settling better
runners_data.spotlight: Two seconds before a respectable run in a quite valuable race on handicap debut at Sandown in April (2m, good); she's up to winning races off this mark; hood fitted for last three races is now removed.

runners_data.name: Best Night
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner but recent efforts have lacked her March winning dash
runners_data.comment: Won at Huntingdon (2m, good) in March but she's taken two backward steps since
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Huntingdon (2m, good) in March but subsequent efforts have lacked the same dash; needs a revival.

runners_data.name: Quick Of The Night
runners_data.note: Long absence following wind surgery but previous form off this mark suggests ability remains
runners_data.spotlight: Not in great form when last seen in October but last July's win at Worcester (2m, good) came after 273 days off following wind surgery, and off this very mark; wouldn't rule out.

runners_data.name: Blackwater Lilly
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare coming off a shocker in first-time visor just three days ago
runners_data.comment: Ran well on recent stable debut; can make presence felt again in new headgear
runners_data.spotlight: Has the form to get in contention but she had a shocker when tailed off in a first-time visor at Fakenham on Sunday; cheekpieces soon return.

runners_data.name: Granny B
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated runner who is winless over hurdles in seventeen attempts
runners_data.spotlight: Flat winner but 0-17 over hurdles and her third two runs ago was remote; opposable.

runners_data.name: Beorma
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in great form after winning chase debut in tongue-tie last week
runners_data.comment: Tongue tied when impressive chase winner at Worcester latest; leading claims off same mark
runners_data.spotlight: In a first-time tongue-tie when winning easily on last week's chase debut at Worcester (2m, good) and overcame a scare at the last flight to comfortably exploit the same mark back over hurdles at Southwell on Tuesday; carries a penalty but looks very well in.

races.paceDynamic: Best Night is the only confirmed front runner and will be allowed an uncontested lead over this 2m trip. With Siorai and Beorma likely to track in second and third, the pace will be genuine but sustainable with no early pressure on the leader. The lack of pace pressure means Best Night can dictate terms and kick clear, while the prominent runners get first run on the hold-up horses. This race shape strongly favours the early leaders and prominent runners who can position close to the pace from the start.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dictates
scenarios.trigger: If Best Night gets an easy lead and finds her March Huntingdon form
scenarios.body: She can control the race from the front and use her tactical advantage to kick clear when the pace lifts. The lack of pace pressure allows her to conserve energy for a strong finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Siorai or Beorma can track the leader and outkick her in the straight
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the field and can capitalize on their forward positions. Siorai's class or Beorma's recent winning form could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly testing and the leaders weaken in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Northern Air's hold-up style could benefit from a strong pace collapse. Her Newton Abbot second suggests she has the class to pick up the pieces late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Quick Of The Night reproduces her July Worcester form after the long break
scenarios.body: Her previous win came off this exact mark after a similar layoff following wind surgery. The gap could have freshened her up significantly.

watchPoints.text: Blackwater Lilly had an absolute shocker when tailed off at Fakenham just three days ago and may not have recovered
Best Night needs to find her March form as subsequent efforts have been disappointing for a front runner with tactical advantage
Quick Of The Night returning after 228 days off but her last win came off this exact mark following similar surgery layoff
Beorma's tongue-tie worked perfectly in her chase win last week and could provide further improvement back over hurdles
Northern Air and other hold-up runners face a tactical disadvantage with Best Night likely to get an easy lead

races.name: Taylor Wimpey Strategic Land Midlands Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Theonlywayiswessex
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with solid recent C&D form but faces the tactical challenge of giving Royal Deeside first run from the front.
runners_data.spotlight: On a fairly tough mark but otherwise has plenty in his favour and ran a solid second over C&D last time; every chance.

runners_data.name: Royal Deeside
runners_data.note: Natural leader who won both chase victories over this trip/ground combination and enjoys a significant 14lb weight pull over main rivals.
runners_data.comment: Both wins over 2m4f at Hexham in 2025; close third over same C&D last time; a possible
runners_data.spotlight: Both chase wins were over 2m4f on good ground at Hexham and nearly won again at Kelso ten days ago when headed on the run-in; same mark.

runners_data.name: Zestful Hope
runners_data.note: Front-running type returning from 101-day break with previous course victory but concerning recent form since October win.
runners_data.spotlight: Five wins include two over fences, the latest at Huntingdon in October (2m4f, good) when 2lb higher; not so good in his five subsequent defeats and record when fresh is modest.

runners_data.name: Therhythmofthenite
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer making chase debut after poor recent hurdle form, represents unknown quantity with first-time tongue-tie.
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth of 24 in a Punchestown maiden hurdle (2m4f, soft to heavy) in November but beaten 40l in his two starts since; tongue tied all runs, hooded latest; first run since leaving Martin Brassil for £21,000 in February.

runners_data.name: Bahtiyar
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with 36-race losing streak but showed life in recent Plumpton second and benefits from lowest weight in field.
runners_data.comment: On a tough mark but he's been consistent without winning and can play a part.
runners_data.spotlight: Only three completed when runner-up last week at Plumpton (2m4f, good) and that extended his losing sequence under rules to 36.

races.paceDynamic: Royal Deeside will lead from the start and likely control the tempo given he's the only confirmed front runner in this small field. With Zestful Hope sitting prominently behind him and three hold-up horses (Theonlywayiswessex, Therhythmofthenite, Bahtiyar) tracking, the pace should be sustainable rather than punishing. The tactical setup creates a race where Royal Deeside can dictate terms without early pressure, building a rhythm that may prove difficult for the hold-up brigade to reel in. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and the leader, as the lack of early pace pressure allows front runners to conserve energy for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Royal Deeside Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Royal Deeside gets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady gallop
scenarios.body: He can use his 14lb weight advantage to kick clear approaching the last fence, with the hold-up horses left with too much to do. Zestful Hope may track him into contention but lack the finishing kick needed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and Royal Deeside weakens in the closing stages
scenarios.body: Theonlywayiswessex can use his superior class (OR 107) and recent C&D form to time his challenge perfectly from off the pace. The sustained gallop plays into the hands of proven stayers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Zestful Hope presses Royal Deeside earlier than expected creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: Both front runners may weaken, allowing either Theonlywayiswessex to sweep past or creating an upset opportunity. The increased tempo exposes fitness concerns after long layoffs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites fail to fire and connections issues affect the main contenders
scenarios.body: Bahtiyar could capitalize on his recent second at Plumpton despite his long losing sequence, benefiting from the low weight. Therhythmofthenite remains a complete unknown making his chase debut.

watchPoints.text: Royal Deeside getting an uncontested lead through the early stages as his front-running style could prove unbeatable with the weight advantage
Zestful Hope's jumping and fitness after 101 days off, as any early mistakes could derail his prominent racing style
Theonlywayiswessex getting into contention turning for home, as his hold-up style needs the race to unfold perfectly
Therhythmofthenite's jumping on chase debut and whether the tongue-tie produces improvement from recent poor form
How aggressively James Bowen rides Zestful Hope early, as pressing the pace could set up the race for the hold-up horses
